correctness.rationale: At the source Corollary 2 (preprint Corollary 6), the prescribed one-point H=R family W=H, v=1, Lambda=2I and Theta=sqrt(5)I satisfies A=B=4 and sum ||(Lambda*Lambda-Theta*Theta)f||=||f||, hence R=1<A. The printed min{B+R sqrt(B/A),R+sqrt(B)}=min{5,3}=3 while actual perturbed quadratic energy is 5||f||^2; numerical claim false. For arbitrary index sets the hypothesis makes the coefficient-operator difference series absolutely convergent on each vector, and its sum D=S_Theta-S_Lambda is bounded self-adjoint with ||D||<=R. Thus -RI<=D<=RI, so (A-R)I<=S_Theta<= (B+R)I, giving frame bounds with R<A. Scalar one-point systems Theta=sqrt(c+R)I and sqrt(c-R)I attain both endpoints for any c>R. All steps use the stated source summed action operator difference, not the different analysis-operator perturbation metric. Exact scalar witness recomputed independently.
